_source: registry/skills_plan.json (kit_plan.yml -> skills_assignment, carried in the kit with its amendments) -> rows (the ONE source of truth), normalised by NONROUTED_INHERIT (a mirror/symlink of a non-routed row inherits its kind, no route); regenerate with python3 tools/kit/skills_index.py --write-assignment --plan registry/skills_plan.json --census <SKILL_CENSUS.yml>

census_copyleft_prose_withheld.rule: NONPERMISSIVE_PROSE_WITHHELD: a GPL-family or CC-BY-NC row (licence from registry/sources.json, else the census repo_licence) ships description '' + description_withheld (licence, sha256 of the upstream text); every other key kept
